value: Analysis uses seller-order grain (one row per seller_id + order_id); 100010 seller-order records span 98666 unique orders.
Multi-seller orders affect 2622 seller-order rows across 1278 orders; delivery outcomes are order-level and shared across sellers fulfilling the same order.
The score does not assign full multi-seller order blame to one seller; each seller is evaluated on their seller-order records with shared delivery outcomes.
